tasks.task_name: Define process tracking types and ProcessStore interface in internal/process package
tasks.goal: A new internal/process package exists with ProcessRecord struct (feature, role, pid, status, started_at, ended_at, exit_code fields), ProcessEvent types (process_started, process_ended, process_lost), ProcessStore interface (Save, UpdateEnd, MarkLostOnStartup, List with filter params), SignalSender interface, and all status constants (running, exited, killed, lost).

outputs.name: types_source
outputs.constraints: all structs have json tags; status constants are typed strings

outputs.name: store_interface
outputs.constraints: ProcessStore interface with Save, UpdateEnd, MarkLostOnStartup, List methods

outputs.name: signal_interface
outputs.constraints: SignalSender interface with Send(pid int, sig syscall.Signal) error

acceptance: ProcessRecord struct has fields: Feature string, Role string, PID int, Status string, StartedAt time.Time, EndedAt *time.Time, ExitCode *int with json tags matching spec Dataset 3
StatusRunning, StatusExited, StatusKilled, StatusLost constants equal 'running', 'exited', 'killed', 'lost'
ProcessStartedEvent struct has fields: Type string, Feature string, Role string, PID int, StartedAt string (RFC3339) with json tags
ProcessEndedEvent struct has fields: Type string, PID int, ExitCode int, Status string, EndedAt string (RFC3339) with json tags
ProcessLostEvent struct has fields: Type string, PID int, Feature string, Role string with json tags
ProcessStore interface declares Save, UpdateEnd, MarkLostOnStartup, List methods
SignalSender interface declares Send(pid int, sig syscall.Signal) error method
go build ./internal/process/... succeeds with zero errors

depends_on.reason: First task, new package with no dependencies on other new code

constraints: Package must be internal/process per FR-026
Must not import internal/specworkflow or internal/api

tasks.task_name: Implement SQLite-backed ProcessStore with startup recovery
tasks.goal: A SQLiteProcessStore implementation persists ProcessRecord to an agent_processes table in the existing metrics.db, supports Save/UpdateEnd/List with feature and status filters, and MarkLostOnStartup atomically updates all status=running records to status=lost and returns the affected records.

outputs.name: store_tests
outputs.constraints: covers all 11 status transition cases from Dataset 2

acceptance: TestProcessStore_SaveAndLoad: save a record, query it back, all fields match including feature, role, pid, status, started_at
TestProcessStore_MarkLostOnStartup: insert records with status=running, call MarkLostOnStartup, verify status changed to lost
TestProcessStore_TerminatedRecordsUnchanged: insert records with status=exited and status=killed, call MarkLostOnStartup, verify both records retain original status
List with feature filter returns only records matching that feature
List with status filter returns only records matching that status
List with invalid status parameter returns error
List returns max 500 records ordered by started_at descending per FR-006
go test ./internal/process/ -run TestProcessStore passes
constraints: Use modernc.org/sqlite driver consistent with existing codebase
Bounded retries (max 3, exponential backoff capped at 500ms) on write failures per FR-004
MarkLostOnStartup failure must return error (caller handles fatal exit per FR-005)

tasks.task_name: Implement ProcessTracker with runtime map, event emission, and kill-request flag
tasks.goal: ProcessTracker manages an in-memory runtime map of pid to os.Process, emits ProcessStartedEvent/ProcessEndedEvent/ProcessLostEvent via a broadcast callback, persists records via ProcessStore, and supports atomic running-to-kill-requested transitions under a sync.Mutex.

outputs.name: tracker_source
outputs.constraints: ProcessTracker struct with RecordStart, RecordEnd, MarkKillRequested, IsKillRequested, GetProcess, StartupRecovery methods

outputs.name: tracker_tests
outputs.constraints: covers event emission, kill flag, runtime map lifecycle

acceptance: TestProcessTracker_EmitsStartedEvent: RecordStart emits ProcessStartedEvent with correct feature, role, pid, started_at via broadcast callback
TestProcessTracker_EmitsEndedEvent: RecordEnd emits ProcessEndedEvent with correct pid, exit_code, status=exited, ended_at
TestProcessTracker_EmitsKilledStatus: RecordEnd with kill-requested flag set emits status=killed
TestProcessTracker_EmitsEndedEvent_WithoutFeatureRole: ProcessEndedEvent does not require feature/role fields per Dataset 3
TestProcessTracker_NoEventOnStoreFailure: if ProcessStore.Save fails, no ProcessStartedEvent is emitted and no runtime map entry exists
TestProcessTracker_MarkKillRequested: transitions running PID to kill-requested; second call returns error
TestKillService_KillFlagRace: concurrent natural exit and kill request results in status=killed
RecordStart adds pid to runtime map; RecordEnd removes pid from runtime map
StartupRecovery calls MarkLostOnStartup and emits ProcessLostEvent for each affected record
go test ./internal/process/ -run TestProcessTracker passes
constraints: Runtime map protected by sync.Mutex per spec Assumptions
Kill-requested flag checked atomically under same mutex
Nil-safe: if tracker is nil, all methods are no-ops

tasks.task_name: Implement KillService with SIGTERM, SIGKILL escalation, and cancellation
tasks.goal: KillService validates PID, sends SIGTERM via SignalSender, starts a 10-second escalation timer that sends SIGKILL if the process has not exited, and cancels the timer if the process exits before the timeout.

outputs.name: kill_service
outputs.constraints: KillService struct with Kill method returning typed errors

outputs.name: kill_tests
outputs.constraints: covers all kill scenarios from TDD plan tests 7-13

acceptance: TestKillService_SendsSIGTERM: Kill calls SignalSender.Send with SIGTERM for a running PID
TestKillService_EscalatesToSIGKILL: when process does not exit within timeout, SignalSender.Send is called with SIGKILL
TestKillService_CancelsEscalation: when process exits before timeout, no SIGKILL is sent
TestKillService_AlreadyTerminated: Kill returns ErrAlreadyTerminated for PID with status != running
TestKillService_InvalidPID: Kill returns ErrInvalidPID for PID <= 0 without calling SignalSender
TestKillService_UnknownPID: Kill returns ErrNotFound for PID not in process store
TestKillService_EPERM: EPERM from SignalSender surfaces as ErrPermissionDenied
TestKillService_SimultaneousRequests: second concurrent kill for same PID returns ErrAlreadyTerminated
On graceful server shutdown, pending escalation timers are cancelled and SIGKILL sent immediately per FR-009
go test ./internal/process/ -run TestKillService passes
constraints: Escalation uses select with cancel channel, not sleep per Dataset 4 note
Timeout configurable via constructor parameter

tasks.task_name: Inject ProcessTracker into ClaudeRunner and CodexRunner with event emission
tasks.goal: ClaudeRunner and CodexRunner each have Feature, Role, and Tracker fields; Run calls Tracker.RecordStart after cmd.Start() succeeds and Tracker.RecordEnd after cmd.Wait() returns; all existing runner tests pass without modification.

outputs.name: modified_runners
outputs.constraints: Feature, Role, Tracker fields added; Run emits events

outputs.name: integration_tests
outputs.constraints: verify events via channel with real subprocess

acceptance: ClaudeRunner struct has Feature string, Role string, Tracker process.ProcessTracker fields
CodexRunner struct has Feature string, Role string, Tracker process.ProcessTracker fields
All six ClaudeRunner clone methods propagate Feature, Role, Tracker via shallow copy (no code changes needed, verified by test)
TestClaudeRunner_EmitsProcessEvents: real subprocess start emits process_started event with correct feature and role
TestCodexRunner_EmitsProcessEvents: real subprocess start emits process_started event with correct feature and role
TestNoEventOnStartFailure: bad binary path produces no process_started event and no store record
All existing TestClaudeRunner_* and TestCodexRunner_* tests pass without modification (SC-006)
go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestClaudeRunner passes
go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestCodexRunner passes
constraints: Tracker is nil-safe: nil tracker means no-op, existing tests unaffected
Feature and Role set at construction time in orchestrator

tasks.task_name: Implement GET /api/processes and POST /api/processes/{pid}/kill HTTP handlers
tasks.goal: GET /api/processes returns a JSON array of process records with optional feature and status query param filters; POST /api/processes/{pid}/kill validates the PID, delegates to KillService, and returns appropriate HTTP status codes (200, 400, 403, 404, 409).

outputs.name: handler_source
outputs.constraints: ProcessHandler struct with List and Kill methods

acceptance: TestProcessHandler_List: GET /api/processes returns 200 with JSON array of records
TestProcessHandler_List_InvalidStatusParam: GET /api/processes?status=pending returns 400 with error JSON
TestProcessHandler_Kill_OK: POST /api/processes/12345/kill for running PID returns 200 with {"status":"kill_accepted"}
TestProcessHandler_Kill_404: POST for unknown PID returns 404 with {"error":"process 99999 not found"}
TestProcessHandler_Kill_409: POST for exited PID returns 409
TestProcessHandler_Kill_403: POST when EPERM returns 403 with {"error":"permission denied: cannot signal process ..."}
TestProcessHandler_Kill_InvalidPID: POST with pid=0, pid=-1, pid=abc returns 400
go test ./internal/process/ -run TestProcessHandler passes
constraints: JSON responses with Content-Type: application/json
Same router pattern as existing handlers in cmd/specworkflow/main.go

tasks.task_name: Wire ProcessTracker, ProcessStore, KillService, and handlers into server startup
tasks.goal: Server main.go initializes SQLiteProcessStore, ProcessTracker, KillService, registers GET /api/processes and POST /api/processes/{pid}/kill routes, runs startup recovery before opening the HTTP listener, and passes tracker to runner constructors.

outputs.name: modified_main
outputs.constraints: ProcessStore, ProcessTracker, KillService initialized; routes registered; recovery runs before listen

acceptance: Server starts successfully with ProcessStore, ProcessTracker, and KillService initialized
GET /api/processes is reachable and returns 200
POST /api/processes/99999/kill returns 404 (proves route is registered)
Startup recovery completes before HTTP listener opens (FR-005)
If startup recovery fails, server exits with fatal error (FR-005)
KillEscalationTimeout is configurable via YAML config with default 10s (FR-024)
ProcessTracker is passed to runner constructors with feature and role set
go build ./cmd/specworkflow/ succeeds
constraints: Recovery must complete before HTTP listener per FR-005
Config uses existing YAML pattern

tasks.goal: A Running Agents tab in the sidebar (between Controls and Spec) displays a table with columns Feature, Role, PID, Start Time, Status, Action; populates initial state from GET /api/processes; updates rows in real time via WebSocket events; shows Kill button only on running rows with confirmation prompt and Killing... state.

outputs.name: html_update
outputs.constraints: new sidebar tab with table markup

outputs.name: js_update
outputs.constraints: fetch, WebSocket event handlers, kill flow

outputs.name: css_update
outputs.constraints: table styling, monospace PID, status badges

acceptance: Running Agents tab appears in sidebar between Controls and Spec (FR-016)
Table has columns: Feature, Role, PID, Start Time, Status, Action (FR-017)
PID column is right-aligned with monospace font (FR-017)
Running rows are pinned to top of table; within each status group, sorted by started_at descending (FR-017)
Tab fetches GET /api/processes on every open/activation (FR-018)
New process_started WebSocket event adds a row without page reload (FR-018)
process_ended and process_lost events update existing rows in real time (FR-019)
Kill button shown only on status=running rows (FR-020)
Kill button shows confirmation prompt before sending request (FR-021)
Kill button becomes disabled with label 'Killing...' after request sent (FR-022)

Kill cancel aborts without sending any request

Must not duplicate stdout/stderr streaming already in Messages tab

tasks.task_name: Write integration tests for full process lifecycle and kill flow
tasks.goal: Integration tests verify the complete flow: runner start emits event, process record persists across store reopen, kill endpoint terminates a real subprocess, SIGKILL escalation fires for SIGTERM-ignoring process, and startup recovery marks stale records as lost.

outputs.name: integration_tests
outputs.constraints: real SQLite, real subprocess, real HTTP handlers

acceptance: TestProcessStore_Integration: write record, close DB, reopen, query returns same record (TDD test 23)
TestKillFlow_Integration: start real subprocess, call kill endpoint, verify process is dead within 15 seconds (TDD test 24)
TestKillFlow_EscalationIntegration: start SIGTERM-ignoring subprocess, call kill, verify SIGKILL fires after ~10s (TDD test 25)
TestStartupRecovery_Integration: write running record, call startup recovery, verify status=lost; verify recovery failure causes error return (TDD test 26)
All tests use real SQLite in temp directory, not mocks
go test ./internal/process/ -run Integration passes
constraints: Tests must clean up temp files and subprocesses
SIGKILL escalation test may need build tag for CI environments that restrict signals
